scripts.deploy: npm run db:initialize && npm run db:migrate && wrangler deploy

REGISTRATION_ACCESS_KEY.description: A private random value of at least 32 characters used to open the read-only dashboard and create one-use device links. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`; it is exchanged for a short-lived browser session and is never placed in the QR code.

CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: A separate private random value of at least 32 characters used to encrypt provider credentials before storing them in D1. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and never enter it in the app.
